collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — BEYOND THE HORIZON, EVENTS 081 to 130 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more speculative branching events continuing "Isola — Beyond the Horizon" (001-080), in the same format: EVENT nnn — TITLE, SETUP, choices A/B/C, two mutually exclusive outcomes per choice, and an optional "Content note:".

ledger.why: the owner (2026-11-15): the person the event is about is a cast villager shown by name, the role word kept as flavor (the villager need not have that job)

collection.description: A healer wonders whether distant healers combine medicine with prayer, as some Isolan healers do.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (Name1), a healer, wonders whether distant healers combine medicine with prayer, as some Isolan healers do.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The healer imagines distant healers using herbs and quiet words, just as they do.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: A skeptical healer imagines distant healers relying only on what they can measure.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: A scholar wonders whether some distant healers might use methods no one here could imagine.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: An elder says every tradition has something to learn and something to question.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The healers agree that care and attention matter everywhere.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: They disagree about the role of prayer and agree to respect each other's ways.
